method: Every assigned edge was manually assessed from bounded complete relevant source extracts; source hashes verified. Formatting scripts did not determine judgments. Additional threshold/identity sources are listed per edge.
limitations: Most identity judgments establish D040 sampled-work name/ID compatibility without a profile-wide identity investigation.
OpenAlex repeated construction sources are not independent corroboration.
Selected ambiguous names received bounded live public OpenAlex/ORCID lookups; unresolved identities remain unverifiable.
Structural support weights/count totals were not independently recomputed; semantic existence/minimum-paper thresholds were assessed.
